page.layout: One printed page. One column of running text, with narrow marginal notes at the right edge (cut off by the scan) and a faint note fragment at the left edge. Page number and running head at the top. A catchword at the foot right, below the last line.

main_text.p: armamentarium, & machinas varii generis ad expeditiones maritimas & oppugnationes urbium paratas, quarum struendarum ipsa erat studiosa ac perita: & quia agrum possidebat non admodum felicem, oleas quidem & vites ferentem, sed frumento sterilem, maritimæ magis rei quàm agriculturæ dabat operam. Atque his studiis & apparatu, Romanis sociis & adjutoribus suis, magno sæpe usui vicissim fuit. Spoliis ex hoste frequenter potita, ea velut virtutis suæ & victoriarum monumenta locis publicis suffigere, atque ad posteros transmittere in more habebat. In operibus ejus publicis cum alia erant, tum templa spectatu digna, quorum duo in urbis parte editiore, quam arcem vocabant, alterum Dianæ Ephesinæ, alterum Apollini Delphico sacrum, quòd horum summinum auspiciis primi[illegible, ~2 letters] conditores urbem hic struxisse ferebantur, præcipuâ religione colebantur. Coloniæ ejus feruntur, Rhoë Agatha ad orientem versus ostia Rhodani, Tau-rentium, Olbia, Antipolis, Nicæa ad occidentem, versus Italiam, omnes litori vicinæ. page.notes: Faint, cut-off text in the right margin (near the lines "primi" and "rep-") and at the left edge could not be read; the right-margin marks are shown only as approximate placeholders. The text ends mid-word at the foot of the page ("Stra-" / catchword "bo nu-"). The Greek word "συνέδριον" is doubtful and marked [?]. Show-through from the reverse side at the lower left and foot is not transcribed. "Vsi" corrected to "Usi" is not applied; printed "Vsi" is read as "Usi" under the u/v rule, but the initial letter reads as V in the scan and is kept under that rule. Printed "Massilienses" and "Aristocratica" are normalised to plain s. No printing errors were identified in the legible text.
